To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) right-wing YouTube channels tend to contain a higher degree and a higher frequency of hate, violence and discrimination than the baseline; 2) the content of videos and the comments of users are similar in terms of the degree and frequency of hate, discrimination and violence, but they differ in terms of topics; and 3) right-wing channels contain more discriminatory bias against Islam and Muslims, and more hate and violence against LGBT people, than the baseline.

(a) the right-wing channels are more negative in their language, (b) their videos contain more war-related content, (c) their comments contain more hate speech against Muslims and (d) they contain less hate speech against LGBT people than the baseline channels.
right-wing YouTube channels are associated with more hateful, violent and discriminatory content than a baseline set.

the study of the content of right-wing YouTube channels in order to identify the main topics and biases present in the content and to compare them to a baseline set of videos.
